lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Lower Z-step bend (lower flange to web, about 89 deg), on the outer convex skin. Perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% put the label 0.00/0.02/0.03 mm from the outer apex along the bisector, and the line is parallel. It spans t 0 to 36.3 mm against a visible fold of about 37 mm (edge to edge of the web), so it covers about 97%. The close-ups show the endpoints about 0.3 mm inside the fold's side edges.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Upper Z-step bend (web to upper flange, about 88 deg), on the outer convex skin. Sections at 25/50/75% put the label 0.00/0.02/0.01 mm from the outer apex, and the line is parallel. It spans 35.9 mm against a visible fold of about 36.5 mm, so it covers about 98%.
